## Use Spot Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Spot Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Spot Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Spot Mono coding font

A commercial fixed-width family from Schick Toikka. Spot Mono is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Spot Mono is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Spot Mono FAQ

### Is Spot Mono free?

No. Spot Mono is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Spot Mono support ligatures?

No. Spot Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Spot Mono?

Spot Mono is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
